purpose: Numerical diagnostic scores for the current KeyCLD physical-keypoint interface, with new calibration and test trajectories
score_scope: Video-conditioned structured keypoint output and separately state-supervised dynamics; not a common generated-video-reader leaderboard
reference_generator: Independent ideal closed-chain DOP853 rtol=1e-10 atol=1e-12 max_step=0.002 s; MuJoCo renders exact poses and independently checks rigid mass/bias terms
energy_integration: Exact constant motor work tau*delta(theta), exact constant world-force work F*delta(position), dense trapezoidal friction work; no finite-difference acceleration
native_derivatives: Native ODE velocity/acceleration; independently verify derivative consistency on dense outputs. This is a separate diagnostic derivative track.
geometry_reader: Declared physical B,C,midpoint interface and supplied world calibration. No ground-truth future alignment, IK correction, learned mass or force used by evaluator.
threshold_basis: Engineering diagnostic tolerances fixed before new predictions; independent physical calibration checks measurement floor. These are project choices, not literature or industry standards.

threshold_interpretation.geometry: 1 mm maximum raw length/hinge error, no position projection
threshold_interpretation.dynamics: 0.1 N*m RMS motor torque residual, 5% of the fixed 2 N*m motor command limit
threshold_interpretation.energy: 0.02 J maximum cumulative work-energy residual, 1% of the 2 N*m times 1 rad reference work
threshold_interpretation.prediction: 1 cm per-channel RMS maximum physical point error

calibration_acceptance: Every correct calibration trajectory must pass all six engineering tolerances; no model-dependent threshold inflation
score: 100 * mean over mechanism families of mean over conditions of complete-trajectory joint pass rate
component_scores: 100 * the same macro average of each metric pass indicator; unavailable metric yields no verified pass and has a separate coverage count
derivative_audit: 5-point, quartic centered derivatives of dense Cartesian predicted points vs native derivatives; diagnostic, not a substitute for the independent equations
limitations: One source training seed; new trajectory tests do not establish training-seed robustness
Original video latent keypoints may not be physical hinges; a failed declared output interface is not a proof all generated videos are physically wrong
Source training used zero friction and no variable-load context; these are frozen-transfer conditions
No Delta/Stewart evaluation and no common video reader is claimed
